text:
Brett Howden has six goals in 20 games, and the interesting part is that he's earning them. His individual expected goals per 60 minutes has nearly doubled from last season (1.15 against 0.62), so his six goals sit right on 5.9 expected. A depth forward with no power-play points doesn't usually get this many looks this early.

He got another one Wednesday against Utah, answering right after Utah had cut the Vegas lead to one. Jesse Granger of The Athletic summed it up: "Brett Howden through traffic." That made it 5-3, which is how it finished, Vegas's fourth straight win.

The rest is quieter. He has two points in his last ten games, and his 19% shooting is above our range for him, even if the chances justify more of it than most hot starts. Speed is part of the profile: NHL EDGE counted 53 bursts over 20 mph, 94th percentile. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him getting 1.6 shots per 60 off passes across the slot or from behind the net last season. Watch whether that shot quality holds; it's the real change in his game.
headline: Brett Howden is earning his goals this time
